turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a and an?
turns.tutor:
Look: I see a cat. I see an egg. I use a with cat and an with egg.
So the rule is: use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound.
Right: We have an ice cream. Wrong: We have a ice cream.
Now you try. Choose the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
